_readme: Repeating nights at places that post only on Facebook or nowhere (trivia, open mics, comedy). src_weekly in aggregate.py lists each one for the next 6 weeks. weekday: 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday. nth (optional): only that week of the month (1 = first, 3 = third). verified: the day someone last confirmed it; the daily data check flags rows not re-verified in 60 days. source: where it was confirmed. skip: dates (YYYY-MM-DD) when it is not on.

nights.title: Geeks Who Drink Trivia at Café Berlin
nights.description: Weekly pub quiz run by Geeks Who Drink: two hours of trivia, teams of up to 6, free to play. Doors at 6. Bring a charged phone to submit answers.
nights.source: geekswhodrink.com venue page; COMO Magazine trivia guide

nights.title: As Yet Unnamed Comedy Show (free open mic)
nights.description: Columbia's long-running free comedy open mic, every Tuesday since 2007. Doors at 8, show at 9. Comics can sign up at the door. 21+.
nights.source: The District event listings; COMO Magazine comedy guide

nights.title: Open Mic Night at Fretboard Coffee
nights.description: Monthly open mic on the third Friday: any instrument, music or spoken word. Sign-ups start at 5:30 at the bar.

nights.title: Themed Trivia Night at International Tap House
nights.description: Themed trivia on the first Wednesday of every month. 21+.
nights.source: The District event listings; COMO Magazine trivia guide
